senses.gloss:
f. plur. always (-राः)
The nymphs of Svarga, attendants on INDRA.
E.
अप water, सृ to go, and असि Uṇādi affix: or [] अप्स in the waters, and रस flavour: from their fondness for bathing, or from their being produced at the churning of the ocean.

f. (-रा)
An Apsarā or heavenly nymph.
E.
अप and सृ as before, with अच् aff.
